slots.name: New York campaign spending
slots.sentence: Throughout 2026, campaign finance records show Accurso has spent $12,000 on various New York races with candidates of similar views.

slots.name: Niou donation
slots.sentence: The children’s educator donated $5,000 to former New York State Assemblymember Yuh-Line Niou’s state Senate campaign, plus an additional $3,500 to Democratic socialist Darializa Avila Chevalier and $4,500 to former New York City Comptroller Brad Lander.
